generationInputs.prompt: Placed squarely in the center of a light gray background is a realistic CD jewel case, showcasing the cover art for a fictional album. The jewel case is cleanly lit with soft reflections and light shadows, clearly showing the square album insert inside. The insert features minimalist, retro-style vector artwork with flat colors and bold outlines, no gradients or textures. The illustration has a melancholy mood with cooler hues, sparse layout, and abstract imagery. A polished, clear diamond with brilliant facets is depicted in the center, with white smoke swirling around its left side. To the right of the diamond, a peach, an eggplant, and a clear plastic syringe with a light blue tip are positioned vertically. All subjects are stylized into simplified graphic forms with bold shapes and thick outlines. A bold album title in a wide, rounded typeface is present. A fictional label name and logo are in one corner. The composition feels polished and editorial.
